card.name: Geography words leading to European places
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, the, of, for, and) and the start of place names in geography text about Europe, just before a region or direction like Central Europe, west, or Alpokalja.

modes.label: Linking word before a region
modes.description: A small word such as in, of, to the, or for right before a European region or compass direction.
modes.example: Hungary is a country<< in>> Central Europe.

modes.label: Start of a place name
modes.description: The first piece of a Hungarian mountain name like Alpokalja.
modes.example: from west to east:<< Al>>pokalja, Transdanub

modes.label: Stray medical case
modes.description: One medical sentence where of follows risk.
modes.example: an increase in the risk<< of>> cervical intraepithelial neoplas

card.writes: No clear meaning; the suppressed tokens are mostly the word political, so it may steer away from political continuations.
